scope: Python wheel security, redaction, compliance and cryptographic configuration
verification: Real bounded workers and independent pikepdf/PyMuPDF inspection; no blanket accuracy qualification

capabilities.limits: Authenticated bounded input; passwords travel only in worker stdin; flags remain advisory, not enforced by native engine

capabilities.failure: 0.3.78 AES-256 V=5/R=6 output is rejected by qpdf: some encryption dictionary parameters are missing or wrong type. MuPDF accepts it. Independent rejection prevents publishing it as successful encryption.
capabilities.mapping: Native allow_print also sets high-quality print; allow_modify also sets assembly; allow_annotate also sets form filling; accessibility is always true. The binding does not expose independent controls for those flags.

capabilities.failure: Authenticated reader state is not transferred when ensure_editor reopens encrypted source bytes. A valid encrypted input can be inspected but plain rewrite fails; no output is kept.

capabilities.limits: 100 signatures; native enumeration only visits AcroForm-linked fields. Independent object inventory reports unlinked signature dictionaries and produces partial status. verify_detached uses original full bytes; verify alone is not substituted because it omits document-digest validation.
unsupported: unknown digest or absent signed attributes
capabilities.known_failure: Ordinary zero-padded /Contents is rejected as trailing DER data; this cryptographically valid fixture remains an explicit partial/unverifiable result. Exact-DER-length linked fixtures verify and same-length document mutation fails for all four tested algorithm paths.

capabilities.limits: 100 blobs/category and 1 MiB total; report hashes/sizes only, no certificate or revocation blobs exported. Presence and PAdES classification are not cryptographic trust validation. has_document_timestamp is a presence signal.

Only public DER certificates already embedded in the input PDF DSS are parsed. No arbitrary certificate-file or credential-store access. is_valid checks the time window only; trust chains and revocation remain not checked. Certificate has no public direct constructor in the binding; loading occurs through the static loader.

At most 100 existing PDF DocTimeStamp dictionaries and 1 MiB token bytes. Read-only parse and token selfcheck, without TSA/network access. Bare TSTInfo metadata parsing is tested; its signature verification remains unsupported without a CMS wrapper. Even a valid token signature does not verify the PDF byte-range imprint, certificate trust or revocation. Positive CMS timestamp-token selfcheck remains unqualified. No direct Timestamp constructor is provided; parse is the factory.
capabilities.binding_export_note: Timestamp and TsaClient are present in the extension pdf_oxide.pdf_oxide but are omitted from the 0.3.78 top-level pdf_oxide.__init__ exports.

capabilities.reason: Client construction and timestamp requests belong to the separately reviewed external-service/signing workflow. The bounded adapter neither creates a client nor permits network access. No persistent service is installed.

No real key/certificate credential ingestion, signing or timestamp request is authorized by this integration. Ephemeral synthetic keys are used only in tests, never stored. Certificate.load_pem/load_pkcs12 and RevocationMaterial construction are not exposed outside that gated workflow. PadesLevel values are read for classification, not permission to sign. B_T/B_LT require separately reviewed timestamp service access; B_LTA is reserved upstream. No product signing stub is represented as complete.
capabilities.observed_failure: Native sign_pdf_bytes emits an unlinked signature dictionary invisible to native AcroForm enumeration; independent inventory records this limitation.

capabilities.limits: Published Linux wheel exposes only rust-crypto. fips-strict fails explicitly, with no fallback. No global application or repository security setting is modified. Individual allow/deny grammar clauses are not exposed as arbitrary user strings.

100 pages and 100 explicit rectangles, unrotated PDF user-space xyxy coordinates. Independent preflight rejects images, Form XObjects, painted vectors, layers, forms, annotations, active actions and embedded files. The wired native engine removes text only; image/path-prune modules are not wired into this API. Unsupported font encodings fail rather than yielding an overlay-only result. Full nonincremental rewrite and explicit document sanitizer follow.
capabilities.qualification: Synthetic original target text and numbers disappear from extracted text and content streams while unrelated numbers remain. Complete secure redaction and every font/geometry representation remain unqualified.

capabilities.reason: Mask/mark state does not independently demonstrate underlying content removal. Product route uses explicit destructive text API plus bounded preflight instead.

capabilities.limits: Only documented Info/catalog XMP/action/name-tree cleanup is claimed. Associated-file /AF arrays, page/field actions and shared attachments may retain content. Independent residual inventory reports these carriers and produces partial status. Not a safe-document or anonymization guarantee.
100 pages; preserve all native errors and warnings. No independent standards certification or accessibility assurance.

100 pages; reopen actual serialized copy and rerun validation. Conversion success can downgrade missing Symbol/ZapfDingbats fonts to warnings. Incomplete conversion produces partial candidate status; source and independent visual review remain required. PDF/UA and PDF/X conversion are not provided by this binding.

acceptance_hold: Parent Ada's source/output visual and numeric checks remain required; no merge/release qualification is granted by these tests.
